    Sorry to belabor this issue, but for the record some MACSYMA save files 
    contain exactly such symbols.  That's how quoted-strings are implemented 
    in MACSYMA.  That's one of the reasons I've been raising a ruckus about 
    this issue and requesting some sort of transitional period.  To cut down 
    on lossage.
So if I understand you, there still is no problem, since these "symbols"
are pseudo-strings used for commentary, and won't be affected by an 
ocasion insertion of a CR.
